insights.geography: Only 9.4% of individual donation dollars come from NC constituents. California alone sends 2.5x more. The DC/VA/MD Beltway corridor contributes $210K+ — nearly double his own constituents.
insights.pacs: AIPAC bundled $274,444 through 242 earmarked transactions, plus $5,000 direct and $1,000 DMFI. Total: $280,444 — 20.8% of all individual dollars. AIPAC is the #2 overall source of money to this campaign.
insights.donationSize: Davis has more small-dollar activity than Cuellar (603 donations under $100), but those account for just 1.2% of total individual money. The $2,500–$3,500 bracket dominates with $468K.
insights.notable: Eric Laufer and Giovanna Randall maxed out to both Davis and Cuellar — a pattern consistent with coordinated AIPAC bundling across vulnerable Democratic incumbents.
